messages.content: Can you find me any upcoming rock and jazz concerts for the next month in San Francisco, California and New York, New York?

We need to find upcoming rock and jazz concerts for the next month. So we need to call for each city and each genre? Thus we will call four times: SF rock, SF jazz, NY rock, NY jazz. Or we could combine into two calls: one for each city with music_genre "rock, jazz"? But function expects a string; maybe we can pass "rock, jazz" but not sure. Safer to do four calls.
